header.description: The `aliases` option and its `rewriteAliases` sibling, mined from @stylexjs/babel-plugin 0.19.0 run live: option shapes, declaration-order precedence with first-that-resolves-on-disk winning, the extension outer loop interleaved with the alias inner loop, the /ROOT/ and absolute existsSync branches (directories resolve, symlinks are not realpathed), relative specifiers bypassing aliases, the theme-file gate on the raw specifier, and rewriteAliases' hardcoded .stylex suffix. The three experimental_crossFileParsing probes of the source corpus are excluded: that resolution mode is a separate open gap. Nine probes numbered 4xx cover edges the source spec left unexecuted (treeshakeCompensation interaction, a literal-percent absolute target, dot-leading specifiers, a non-boolean rewriteAliases, before/after overlap in a star key, /ROOT/ join normalization) and were executed against the same oracle.
